title: The unexpectedly heavy box
situation: A casual bend and a tug: the box does not move and the body jerks against it. Then the real lift: knees deep, back straight, hands lower, and up with effort. Once lifted, the box's weight is part of the centre of mass.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
